errorCodes.meaning: No slot the caller may read has this `mnemonic`. Returned alike for a slot that does not exist and for one the caller does not own, so the code cannot be used to learn which slots exist.
The submitted `domain` is not a known hosting domain on this consumer. See [category conventions](../../../_shared/0.1/CONVENTIONS.md#2-unknown-domain-error).

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.

lastResolvedAt.description: Absent when the scope has never been resolved.

domain.description: Disambiguates `mnemonic` per the category conventions. Absent means the domain is resolved by the category's chain. MUST NOT be present without `mnemonic`: this task has no per-domain aggregate (did-management/stats/timeseries does).

mnemonic.description: The slot whose counters are read. Absent means the hosting service's server-wide aggregate, which only an administrator may read.
